description: China - Energy Saving Management Action Plan for Liaoning Safe & Sustainable Urban Water Supply Project is a dataset listed in energydata.info, an open data portal for energy in developing countries under the section "Energy efficiency, Water", published or maintained by Kal Jamal (World Bank Group). Report that contains energy efficiency and Non-revenue-Water target data in Shenyang, Anshan, Fushun, Fuxin and Gaizhou water companies in Liaoning Province, China. Coverage: China. It has 2 files in XLS, PDF. The portal files it under Energy efficiency, Water. The portal gives 2017 as the release date. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support power-system and electrification planning studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-energydata-info-world-bank.
